criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Prevention and Precautions
categories.definition: User seeks advice on how to prevent infection or protect oneself and others through behaviors like masking, distancing, hygiene, or ventilation.

categories.name: Transmission and Surface Survival
categories.definition: User asks about how the virus spreads, survival duration on specific surfaces, or the risk of transmission via objects, animals, or specific activities.

categories.name: Treatments and Remedies
categories.definition: User inquires about medical treatments, cures, home remedies, or medication for COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccines
categories.definition: User asks about the existence, availability, or development status of a COVID-19 vaccine.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: User asks about specific symptoms, checks if personal symptoms indicate infection, or seeks information on how to identify the disease.

categories.name: Statistics and Data
categories.definition: User requests specific numbers, case counts, death rates, or recovery statistics for specific locations or globally.

categories.name: Travel and Movement Restrictions
categories.definition: User asks about travel safety, transport cancellations, or restrictions on movement between locations.

categories.name: High Risk Areas and Protocols
categories.definition: User asks to identify high-risk locations or asks about specific rules and protocols for visiting or living in such areas.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: User requests the latest news, general updates, press releases, or current developments regarding the pandemic.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks to verify or debunk specific claims, hoaxes, conspiracy theories, or myths regarding the virus.

categories.name: General Information and Definition
categories.definition: User requests a broad overview, definition, or explanation of what COVID-19 is.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to donate money, find donation options, or support relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing and Social Actions
categories.definition: User requests to share the bot, information, or links via social media or messaging platforms.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: User greets the bot, expresses thanks, or provides general feedback without asking a specific question.
